# Brock Simon

> Product leader and advisor: co-founder and Chief Product Officer at Native, external advisor to Bain & Company, and advisor to Provenance and Eureka AI. Former Expert Partner at Bain & Company, with earlier analytics leadership at McKinsey & Company and dunnhumby.

As of 2026-10-16, Brock Simon is co-founder and Chief Product Officer at Native (since January 2026) and holds advisory roles with Bain & Company (External Advisor), Provenance (Advisor), Eureka AI (Advisor). Brock is also a ski coach at Palisades Tahoe. Facts last verified by the owner: 2026-10-16. Record id https://brockdsimon.com/profile.jsonld#person.

Publication: Brock Simon has approved this record.

The homepage at https://brockdsimon.com/ says only "This site isn't for humans." and points here. That is deliberate: the content is in the files below.

## Files

- [profile.json](https://brockdsimon.com/profile.json): the record itself, format brockdsimon.com/profile-record 4.1. Primary. Every other file is generated from it.
- [profile.jsonld](https://brockdsimon.com/profile.jsonld): the same facts as a schema.org graph (Person, OrganizationRole, Organization, Project, Article, Book, PodcastEpisode, Event, Quotation, NewsArticle, Question, CreativeWork for each source).
- [profile.md](https://brockdsimon.com/profile.md): the record as Markdown, with contribution, context and results kept apart for each programme.
- [llms-full.txt](https://brockdsimon.com/llms-full.txt): the record as one plain-text file.
- [profile](https://brockdsimon.com/profile): the same record as one HTML page, for browsers and search engines; it opens with the front page's line. The page to cite: every item has an anchor on it (the links in this file use them), and profile.json gives each item's citation URL.
- [feed.xml](https://brockdsimon.com/feed.xml): Atom feed of changes to the record.
- [profile.schema.json](https://brockdsimon.com/profile.schema.json): the JSON Schema that profile.json validates against, with every field described.
- [sitemap.xml](https://brockdsimon.com/sitemap.xml) and [api-catalog](https://brockdsimon.com/.well-known/api-catalog): where the files are.

## About this record

This profile is generated from one record that Brock Simon maintains with help from an AI assistant. Every item carries an evidence label and lists its sources; the claims list holds atomic statements, with a locator into the source where known. Company descriptions use only each company's own public website. Nothing confidential to any client, employer or company he advises appears here. Maintained by Brock Simon with the help of an AI assistant. Facts come from his own profile record, his LinkedIn experience section as he supplied it, and the public pages cited on each item; every URL was opened before it was cited. Every item in profile.json (each role, programme, work, appearance, statement and source) cites its sources and carries an evidence label (documented, self_reported, owner_perspective); sourcing is at item level. The claims list holds 25 atomic statements, each with one subject, its sources, a relationship (held_role, worked_on, helped_establish, led_team, described_programme, public_spokesperson, named_team_acknowledgment, context_only, endorsed, acknowledged_reader, spoke_at, interviewed, authored, named) and, for 24 of them, a locator saying where in the source the support lies. Programme context and programme results are recorded separately from Brock Simon's contribution and are not Brock Simon's personal achievements. Team and programme awards are not personal awards. Dates are given only to the precision the record supports: a year, a month, or a day. A year is never turned into an invented day. Announcement, start, end and publication dates are kept apart.

Crawler policy: search engines, answer engines and user-directed fetchers are allowed; model training is allowed; Content-Signal search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=yes. Private paths: /owner, /api, /mcp, /login, /auth, /posts.

## Areas of experience

- Enterprise data and AI products: Building products that help large organisations understand and use their own data with AI, as co-founder and Chief Product Officer of Native.
- AI strategy for large enterprises: Leading AI initiatives for large enterprise clients as an Expert Partner at Bain & Company, and continuing to advise Bain & Company as an external advisor.
- Advanced analytics and data science leadership: Leading advanced analytics teams and solutions as an Expert Associate Partner at McKinsey & Company in Chicago and Bangkok, and at dunnhumby in Turkey and Asia.
- Retail customer data, loyalty and price and promotion analytics: A decade at dunnhumby working with grocery and retail clients in the US, Thailand, Turkey and across Asia: price and promotion optimisation, loyalty segmentation, promotion evaluation tools, and embedding customer measures into retailer strategy.

## In Brock Simon's own words

- AI-mediated shopping and product data: The bigger shift in AI shopping is discovery moving upstream, before the shopper reaches a retailer. Systems that ground the difference between a marketing claim and a verified one do not yet exist, and both AI models and shoppers are still in a norming stage. <https://www.provenance.org/news-insights/the-future-of-ai-shopping-how-verified-product-data-boosts-ai-discoverability>
- Enterprise AI adoption: AI is less experimental than many executives assume. The advance that matters is putting agents on top of existing models, workflows and best practices, with humans in the loop: augmented decision-making is what is winning in the enterprise. <https://servicepath.co/podcast/revenue-growth-for-tech-execs-edition-13/>
- AI and product decision-making: AI has compressed the time from product design to deployment and from insight to execution, which makes data understanding and data engineering the next bottlenecks for enterprises. <https://www.linkedin.com/posts/brock-simon_how-ai-is-changing-product-decision-making-activity-7457522836241321984-T3X->

## Questions and answers

- Is Brock Simon still at Bain & Company? No. He was Expert Associate Partner at Bain & Company from June 2019 and Expert Partner from July 2022 to November 2025, in San Francisco. Since January 2026 he has been an external advisor to Bain & Company, providing advisory support on select projects, alongside his role as co-founder and Chief Product Officer of Native.
- What is Native, and what is his role there? Native describes its work as database reasoning for complex enterprise data: it helps enterprises understand complex data by reasoning across the data itself, discovering structure, relationships, definitions, exceptions and gaps so teams can build reliable data foundations. Brock Simon is its co-founder and Chief Product Officer, full-time since January 2026 and based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Native's company page gives 2025 as its founding year and lists him among its people.
- What was his title at McKinsey & Company? Expert Associate Partner, in Chicago from August 2015 to August 2017 and in Bangkok from August 2017 to May 2019, as he records it on LinkedIn. Illinois Tech's Marketing Analytics Advisory Council page recorded the title as Expert associate principal, with a focus on marketing and digital analytics in retail and consumer packaged goods.
- Where did he study? Miami University, where he took a BA and an MS in Mathematics and Statistics, and Xavier University, where he took an MBA. Bain's team page and Illinois Tech's council page record the same institutions with slightly different wording of the degrees.
- Is this the same Brock Simon who worked for dunnhumby in Turkey and Shanghai? Yes. His decade at dunnhumby, from 2005 to 2015, ran from Cincinnati through Atlanta, Bangkok, Portland and Izmir to Shanghai, ending as Head of Solutions for Asia. Bain's team page and his LinkedIn both record it. This record is not about other people who share the name.
- What has he written or spoken about? Three Bain & Company articles in 2025, each co-authored: on data monetisation with AI (first-named of five authors, June 2025), Google Cloud Next (first-named of four, April 2025) and Nvidia GTC (second-named of seven, March 2025); a servicePath Executive Conversations podcast on agentic AI, personalisation, loyalty and data monetisation; a Provenance webinar on AI shopping and verified product data; and the MAUSTRAP Podcast on why he founded Native and how AI changes product decisions. profile.json lists each with its link and its byline.
